headline: IEA Projects First Decline in Annual Clean Energy Capacity Growth in Five Years
summary: The International Energy Agency expects global clean energy additions to slow in 2026 for the first time in five years. The head of the agency cited transmission grid bottlenecks and international trade barriers as primary constraints.
why: The International Energy Agency provides authoritative forecasts and policy advice on global energy security and transition trends.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Infrastructure delays and trade friction slow deployment of renewable infrastructure.
